from arc_dsl import *
def transform(grid):
    g=tuple(map(tuple,grid)); h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    objs=[o for o in objects(g,T,F,T)]
    res=[list(r) for r in g]
    for o in objs:
        idx=toindices(o)
        ui,uj=ulcorner(idx); li,lj=lrcorner(idx)
        # top row gaps
        top=[j for j in range(uj,lj+1) if g[ui][j]==0]
        # interior: zeros in bbox
        inter=[(i,j) for i in range(ui,li+1) for j in range(uj,lj+1) if g[i][j]==0]
        if not inter or len(top)!=1: continue
        gj=top[0]
        # fill zeros in bbox with 2
        for i,j in inter: res[i][j]=2
        # direction: longer filled segment on top row
        leftlen=gj-uj; rightlen=lj-gj
        d=-1 if leftlen>=rightlen else 1
        r=ui-1
        if 0<=r<h:
            j=gj
            while 0<=j<w:
                res[r][j]=2; j+=d
    return res
